candidates.description: This feature vector represents common Thai conjunctions, prepositions, and grammatical particles used to connect words and clauses.
This vector represents common Thai consonant and vowel sounds, particularly initial letters and syllable components.
This vector represents multilingual subwords and character sequences with high linguistic noise across disparate languages.
This vector represents a linguistic feature that activates on multilingual sub-word tokens containing the letters "ar".
These tokens represent fragments and misspellings related to the word "affair" or the Thai script character "ฟ".
This vector activates for Thai script characters, diacritics, and Thai song titles or lyrics.
This vector is related to the word "camel" and its translations or character fragments in Thai.
This vector represents Thai script characters and vowel-consonant combinations.
This vector activates on Thai characters and text fragments, specifically capturing common syllable structures and linguistic components in the Thai script.
This vector represents Thai language text processing tokens, particularly modal verbs and common prefixes related to the future tense marker "จะ".
